title: seilbahn deploy result
description: One artifact published by a deploy job, written as JSON by deploy.yml and read by the update-version-manifest action. Validating these before the manifest is written is what keeps a malformed value from being committed to the CDK repo. The `version` and name patterns below therefore mirror bergschacht's version-manifest.schema.json.

name.description: Artifact name - becomes the manifest key CDK looks up.

type.description: Which half of the manifest this lands in - images or lambdas.

repository.description: image only. Full ECR repository URI.

imageTag.description: image only. Tag the image was pushed under.

bucket.description: lambda only. S3 bucket holding the zip.

key.description: lambda only. S3 object key of the zip.

objectVersion.description: lambda only. S3 object version id - what pins the deploy to this exact upload.

package.description: Owning package; identifies the manifest packages entry.

allOf.$comment: an image result carries ECR coordinates and nothing from the lambda side
a lambda result carries S3 coordinates and nothing from the image side

artifactName.description: Must match the manifest's key pattern in bergschacht

version.description: Semantic version, matching the pattern the version manifest enforces.
